jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Role Summary

Leads the design of business-aligned data solutions that translate strategic priorities and product needs into scalable, governed architecture patterns. This role partners closely with business, product, engineering, and architecture stakeholders to assess requirements, define end-to-end solution designs, and ensure data capabilities support operational, analytical, and AI use cases. The role is accountable for connecting business intent to practical architecture decisions while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards, controls, and platform strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Assess business priorities, product requirements, and data needs to define solution architecture approaches.
Translate business use cases into end-to-end data solution designs spanning source systems, integration, storage, consumption, and controls.
Partner with product owners, business stakeholders, data architects, and engineering teams to align solution designs to enterprise standards and delivery priorities.
Define target-state architecture patterns, integration approaches, and data flows for reporting, operational, and AI-enabled use cases.
Lead architecture decisions for new initiatives, enhancements, and platform adoption across business functions.
Ensure solution designs address scalability, resiliency, security, data quality, and governance requirements.
Support prioritization and roadmap planning by evaluating design options, dependencies, trade-offs, and implementation feasibility.
Review proposed solutions and delivery plans to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, product intent, and business outcomes.
Drive consistency in solution design practices, documentation standards, and architecture governance across regions and teams.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams during delivery to ensure architectural integrity.

Required Experience

10+ years of experience in data, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or related technology roles.
Experience designing end-to-end data solutions in complex enterprise environments.
Experience working with business stakeholders to assess requirements, define target-state solutions, and support delivery execution.
Experience in financial services, asset management, or similarly regulated and complex industries.
Experience with enterprise data platforms, integration patterns, reporting ecosystems, and governed data environments.

Skills & Qualifications

Technical knowledge and systems expertise: Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, integration patterns, data platforms, reporting ecosystems, and the architecture foundations required to support analytics, AI, and operational use cases.
Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to assess business needs, evaluate design options, and translate complex requirements into scalable and governed solution architectures.
Communication and collaboration capabilities: Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence skills, with the ability to connect business intent to technical design decisions.
Ability to work in cross-functional or global teams: Experience operating across global teams and coordinating with business, product, architecture, engineering, and governance stakeholders.
Understanding of technology governance, security, or operational practices: Strong understanding of data governance, security, risk management, compliance, and operational standards, with experience embedding them into solution design.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting cloud-based data modernization initiatives and enterprise platform transformations.
Experience designing data solutions that support self-service analytics, advanced analytics, or AI-enabled use cases.
Familiarity with asset management, investment, portfolio, finance, or operational data domains.
Experience establishing reusable architecture patterns, reference designs, and solution governance practices.

Salary Range: $150,000 - $185,000 CAD

Position Opening Reason:

New Position

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. Accordingly, we do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment.

Brookfield is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive organization. We are committed to providing barrier-free and accessible employment practices in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Should you require a Human Rights Code-protected accommodation through any stage of the recruitment process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Technology and Innovation - Associate Director (NetSuite)
jobs.description:
Riveron is looking for an Associate Director to join our Technology and Innovation practice. This client facing role will interact with key leadership (CFO, Controller, etc.) and will contribute to the areas of business development and sales, practice development, and project execution.

As an Associate Director, you will lead the delivery of client engagements, serving as the day-to-day point of contact for the client, guiding a team of consultants through the project lifecycle, and ensuring that high quality projects are consistently executed on time and on budget. While developing your project and people management skills, you will further augment your advisory toolkit by digging deep into client problems in real-time and delivering ongoing thought partnership. With business leaders to guide you along the way – including a dedicated performance advisor – you will contribute to developing the practice as we continue to invest in accelerating your growth.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Accounting, Finance, or Management Information Systems (MIS)
7+ years of implementation or optimization experience and should have prior experience with architecting ERP solutions on NetSuite.
Leading or supporting full-cycle NetSuite Implementations
Previous experience and ability to gather business requirements and effectively implement an ERP, CRM, & PSA solution
Mastery of Microsoft Office Products.
Consulting experience in other business applications including QuickBooks, Intacct, Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and/or PeopleSoft is a plus.
Software as a Service (SaaS) or Cloud experience is a plus.
Certified NetSuite ERP consultant is a plus.
Ability to develop, grow and sustain client relationships.
Entrepreneurial spirit and a solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work in ever-changing, dynamic environments.
Ability to craft and deliver verbal, written, and oral messages and make recommendations to a variety of audiences, including client leadership and internal teams.
Desire to get involved in the Riveron culture and internal initiatives, including community service, training, interviewing, intramurals, and other social/networking activities.
Passionate about best practices and the ability to challenge the need for customization and not just using standard native functionality by configuring the platform.

What You'll Do

Execute Projects

Collaborate with Implementation team members to develop effective and scalable NetSuite solutions. Leverage best practices wherever possible.
Work directly with Implementation team members to develop business requirements and translate requirements into specific NetSuite functionality.
Lead client workshops to define implementation strategy to support the growth of the business requirements.
Lead and/or support implementation team(s) in solution design and work with the implementation team to implement the solution.
Work with client IT teams to ensure that the solution design is well understood by the client. Should be comfortable presenting the solution design to the external and internal teams.
Ensure completion of tasks, milestones, and components including but not limited to functional specifications, design specifications, configurations, quality assurance, implementations and project reviews for engagements.
Define integration requirements and collaborate with integration team to interface other outside applications with NetSuite.
Oversee and lead engagement teams through all phases of a NetSuite ERP implementation or optimization project including business process design, configuration, user acceptance testing, training, cutover and go-live stabilization.

Support Business Development and Sales

Identify expansion opportunities on client engagements to cross-sell Riveron’s services
Participate in pre-sales meetings with current and prospective clients to assess project level-of-effort and to assist in determining in NetSuite is the best fit for requirements presented.
Identify the NetSuite modules and determine the timeline, resource plan, level-of-effort and fee estimates required for implementation in achieving client objectives.

NetSuite Practice Development

Work with practice leadership to develop and deliver NetSuite-specific training, business development training and collateral and engagement materials/templates.

Applications for this evergreen opportunity will be accepted through Dec 31, 2026.

About Riveron

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.

Check Us Out On Social Media

LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook

Riveron Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer and believes that we are stronger together through our diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Full time roles are eligible for a full range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and PTO. A complete description of all available benefits can be found at Riveron's Benefits page at https://riveron.com/riveron-life/. Contract roles are not eligible for benefits.

Fraud Alert

Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are used to support the hiring process in screening, assessing, and/or selecting applicants for this position. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice-President, Technology Lead, Health
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Opportunity

Lead a transformational technology organization powering health and benefits experiences for millions. As the Assistant Vice-President (AVP), Technology Lead
, you will own one of Sun Life Canada’s largest technology portfolios
for health benefits claims adjudication/processing, virtual health, and online pharmacy systems
.

You will lead a 250+ person technology professional organization
including 5 Directors across multiple high-performing squads in a matrixed environment. This is your chance to shape strategy, drive modernization, and build a world-class engineering culture that balances breakthrough innovation with operational excellence.

You'll partner with executives across Architecture, Product, Operations, and Business to define the future of Sun Life's health technology platforms including mission-critical mainframe systems to cutting-edge digital experiences—while managing complex vendor ecosystems and driving sustainable delivery practices.

This role is highly visible, mission-critical to Sun Life Canada’s core business, strategically influential, and demands a leader who thrives in complexity.

Why This Role Matters

You'll lead a strategic inflection point for Sun Life's health benefits claims and on-line health technology organization. Leading one of Sun Life Canada’s largest technology portfolios and 250+ technology professionals, you have the scale, resources, and mandate to drive meaningful modernization while serving millions of members. This is a high-visibility opportunity to influence enterprise technology strategy, build a best-in-class engineering culture, and deliver business impact in a complex, mission-critical environment.

What You'll Own

Technology Strategy & Modernization Leadership

Define and communicate a compelling technology vision that bridges near-term delivery with long-term platform modernization across health benefits claims, adjudication systems, online health platforms, and core systems of record.
Lead evolution of Sun Life's health technology ecosystem—making bold build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in an extremely large technology portfolio
Champion modern engineering practices, technology standards, and architectural excellence while actively managing technical debt in complex, non-greenfield environments
Partner with Business, Architecture, and Enterprise Technology leaders to design resilient, scalable platforms that deliver exceptional member and sponsor experiences

Delivery Excellence at Scale

Accountable for end-to-end delivery across multiple agile squads at varying maturity levels—driving velocity, quality, and reliability improvements
Manage relationships with system integrators and vendors, holding partners accountable for outcomes and knowledge transfer
Serve as the primary escalation point for critical platform and delivery issues in a mission-critical environment
Transform delivery metrics into actionable insights and drive continuous improvement

People Leadership & Culture Building

Lead, mentor, and develop 250+ technology professionals across 5 Director level reports and cross-functional teams
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, execution-focused culture rooted in psychological safety and continuous learning
Design high-performing team structures aligned with business outcomes and technical excellence
Build and retain technical talent through coaching, career development, and hands-on leadership

Financial & Strategic Vendor Management

Own platform budgeting, cost optimization, and capitalization decisions
Manage strategic vendor and SI relationships to maximize delivery quality and ROI
Drive alignment between IT spend and business value delivery

Governance & Risk Management

Establish governance that accelerates delivery while meeting regulatory and security requirements
Ensure platform stability, security, and effective incident/change management for mission-critical systems
Partner with Operations on disaster recovery and business continuity for enablement platforms

Who You Are

Experience & Expertise

10+ years in senior technology leadership roles for very large technology portfolios, with proven success delivering complex, mission-critical systems at enterprise scale
Track record modernizing and enabling technology platforms.
Experience working in a health benefits claims / health industry is good to have
Strong financial acumen—comfortable managing large budgets, vendor portfolios, and ROI optimization
Demonstrated ability to lead technology teams through transformation while maintaining operational excellence
Knowledge with Mainframe environments and their integration with modern and digital business-critical systems is good to have

Technical Credibility & Mindset

Strong technical foundation with the credibility to challenge architecture, delivery practices, CI/CD, and engineering approaches
Builder mentality—equally focused on fixing legacy systems, scaling capabilities, and enabling teams
Decisive leader comfortable making clear decisions amid ambiguity and complexity
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven thinker who balances innovation with stability
Collaborative leader who rebuilds trust, drives momentum, and fosters transparency

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (MBA or advanced degree is an asset)
Experience in regulated health, insurance or financial services is valuable

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only as the position includes managing both French and English-speaking staff (Quebec and outside Quebec) and providing daily support to the team.

What’s in it for you?

Flexible hybrid work model.
Pension, stock and savings programs to help build and enhance your future financial security
Work and professional development that is united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives
A friendly, collaborative and inclusive culture
Be part of our continuous improvement journey in developing the next greatest digital enterprise experience.
Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

145,000/145 000 - 235,000/235 000

Project Management - Systems

jobs.title: Account Director, Enterprise Unit
jobs.description:
Department:
Client Services

Location:
Calgary, Alberta

Compensation:
CA$120,000 - CA$150,000 / year

Description

About The Job

Title
: Account Director - Enterprise Business Unit

Department
: Client Services

Location
: Remote (Canada Preferred but not Required)

Compensation
: $120,000 - $145,000 / year

Employment Type
: Full Time

Reports To
: Portfolio Account Director, Enterprise Business Unit

Who We Are

Clever Digital Marketing (CDM) is a performance marketing agency trusted by the largest home improvement companies across North America. We specialize in scaling client growth through full-funnel paid media strategies and deep business consulting. CDM’s success is powered by its industry-leading reputation for exceptional service delivery and performance, with growth driven almost entirely by client referrals and expansion.

Our Enterprise Business Unit (EBU) partners with home improvement industry leaders managing $500K+ monthly ad budgets. These are high-touch, high-value, performance-obsessed clients.
We operate as strategic advisors to them, integrating deeply with their internal teams to drive measurable growth through not only paid media strategy and execution, but also sales enablement, customer experience, and long-term profitability.

Our agency thrives on accountability, transparency, proactive leadership, and results — and we’re looking for leaders who do too.

The Opportunity

We’re seeking a high-performance Account Director
to lead enterprise-level accounts and client relationships with a deep sense of ownership, authority, and drive
.

You’ll be in the driver’s seat — serving as the face of the agency and a strategic growth partner to your clients. This role is not for the passive or reactive.
You’ll push boundaries, challenge thinking, and anticipate problems before they arise, guiding both clients and internal teams with confidence and clarity.

Operating at the intersection of strategic consulting, performance marketing and analysis, and client leadership
, you’ll oversee as many as 3–5 large-scale accounts, each representing multimillion-dollar marketing investments, and play a key role in driving measurable business growth for your clients and for CDM.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Strategic Advisory

Serve as the primary strategic partner for up to 3–5 enterprise clients ($500K+/month ad spend), driving performance, alignment, and strategic direction.
Act as the primary executive-level advisor for enterprise clients, driving performance, alignment, and strategic direction.
Proactively push client thinking and agency performance, challenging assumptions and guiding toward scalable profitability.
Lead data-driven performance reviews, highlighting insights from ROAS, CPL and conversion rates, to down-funnel sales metrics.
Anticipate client needs, staying several steps ahead with proactive communication and clear recommendations.
Build deep, trust-based relationships with VP and C-suite leaders.
Guide clients with confidence and empathy, challenging thinking when needed to drive results.

Growth & Retention

Own account retention, growth, and revenue forecasting.
Identify opportunities for cross-channel growth and lead upsell conversations with credibility.
Forecast risks early and course-correct quickly, aligning internal teams to deliver solutions.
Lead renewal and expansion conversations with clarity and confidence.

Performance Insight & Decision-Making

Diagnose funnel performance across paid search, paid social, landing pages, and CRM pathways to uncover root causes and optimization opportunities.
Partner with analytics and media teams to connect marketing data to business outcomes.
Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable insights (not just reports) that drive executive-level decisions for your clients.

Leadership & Team Collaboration

Lead cross-functional teams across media, creative, CRO, and analytics to deliver high-impact, performance-driven campaigns.
Model extreme ownership, proactive initiative, and clarity under pressure — the behaviours that build client and team confidence.
Take full ownership of all client meetings, ensuring every touchpoint demonstrates strategic progress and delivers clear value through actionable insights, data analysis, and well-structured narratives.
Operate with a builder’s mindset — identify gaps, create resources, and develop frameworks or tools that enable scalable delivery without waiting for direction.
Mentor and develop the account team, helping refine processes and contributing to the continued evolution of CDM’s Enterprise Unit.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What We Are Looking For:

You’re a driven strategic operator and relationship leader with the composure of a consultant and the hunger of a performance marketer who’s comfortable in high-pressure situations.

About

You believe in ownership, love solving hard problems, and naturally take initiative. You inspire confidence because you do the work, not just talk about it. You’re:

Proactive & Accountable: You don’t wait to be told; you anticipate and act.
Analytical & Commercial: You connect data with business outcomes intuitively.
Assertive & Empathetic: You push when it’s right, and listen when it matters with confident humility.
Calm & Composed: You thrive in fast-paced environments, lead with clarity under pressure, and communicate with polish.
Coachable & Growth-Minded: You see feedback as fuel, not criticism.
A Nature Leader with Presence: You lead with confidence and presence while building trust and collaboration with clients and agency teams alike.
A Builder at Heart: You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves, bringing structure to ambiguity and creating the clarity, tools, and direction that enable your clients and teams to perform at their best.

Qualifications
6+ years of client-facing account leadership experience within performance-driven sectors.
4+ years in a performance marketing or agency environment.
2+ years of supervisory experience.
Proven experience managing $500K+/month accounts with VP/C-suite visibility.
Strong understanding of paid digital media and interpreting full-funnel performance data.
Demonstrated success driving retention, upsell, and proactive client engagement.
Confident communicator, storyteller, and polished presenter, comfortable in executive rooms.
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or analytics (or equivalent experience).
Demonstrated drive, curiosity, initiative, and self-direction; thrives in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness and ability to travel to the United States on a quarterly basis to represent the company at conferences, lead client engagements, and support key relationship-building initiatives
Bonus: Experience in home improvement, home services, or lead generation.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM

Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses
Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)
Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.
Company-provided MacBook computer
Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started
Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!
The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Enterprise Client Success team
A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

Clever Digital Marketing values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of support during the recruitment and selection process. Please note that artificial intelligence (AI) may be utilized during the interview or candidate evaluation process to support the fair and efficient screening, assessment, and selection of applicants.
